one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-29 holds no TT earnings (next print late Jan 2027). reasoning: Round 2. Base rates: TT beat its first annual EPS guide 3 of 3 years (+8.3%, +10.5%, +2.0%) and its first quarterly guide 4 of 4 (Q4'25-Q3'26, median +2.8%), but the beat is shrinking and the reaffirmed FY26 guide implies Q4 $3.40-3.50 vs ~$3.59 pre-print Street; the stock sold the margin, not the demand. Supervisor findings acted on: (1) Americas margin path rebuilt from the FY26 incremental record (my own build gives 23.4%, low 20s) and the 2027 plan of only 20-30bp price over inflation: ~24% incrementals, +35bp FY27 and +21bp FY28 instead of +75/+40bp; (2) MOD and CSW taken out of the medians: 6 whole-company peers, NTM P/E median 18.3x, exit 22.7x; EV/EBITDA on LII/SPXC 14.1x, exit 19.0x at weight 0.25; (3) Q4 guidance_check now has a 4-quarter first-guide record; (4) bridge corrected: supplier finance 393.1 in net debt (verified in the 10-Q), NCI at market 494, asbestos plan less funded QSF 275; shares -1.7% buybacks only; (5) tax 18.5/19/19%. Where I differ: the call transcript I cite does say Q4 price is 'closer to two points at the America segment' (FY ~1pt), so my Q4 Americas revenue stays; the extra -197.5 x 0.4 asbestos item stays out (not found in the 10-Q text I read); EMEA recovers a little slower than round 1 but not as slowly as the supervisor's path. FY27 EPS ~$18.05 adjusted: +2% vs Street $17.71, at the $18.10 whisper. Macro priced by markets: Kalshi 2027 recession ~20%, Fed on hold with hike tail; AHRI resi shipments +6.2% YTD; hyperscaler capex ~$1trn 2027 (Moody's). Scenarios: downside P10 $285 (data-center pause + recession + de-rate), upside P90 $583; left tail fatter (sigma 0.34 vs 0.22). Not driver-linked: none. Research limited to web search/fetch (sec.gov refused a generic scripted fetch; filings read with WebFetch); no option data consulted.
